results.description:
SLOANE

I came to Milwaukee to sell a hockey team.

My father's firm owns forty percent of it. One more losing season and we can force a sale to a buyer who will move it two thousand miles away. I wrote the plan myself. It is clean, it is legal, and it works.

What I didn't plan for was my grandfather waiting for me at the bottom of the airport escalator. Or the room he gave me under the roof of his house, across a shared bathroom from the team's captain.

He makes me toast at five in the morning. By six he can't stand me.

On paper he is exactly what my spreadsheet says. Thirty. Slow. Expiring. The most expensive line in the budget.

He is also the only person in this city who tells me the truth.

And somewhere in my plan, in my own handwriting, is the sentence that sends him away.

KILLIAN

I've been traded three times. I found out about the first one from my phone, sitting alone in a parking lot.

This team is the first place that ever kept me. Now the owner's granddaughter is living across the hall, putting a price on everything I love, and she is very, very good at it.

So we made a deal. Every morning, from five to six, in that kitchen, nothing either of us says counts.

It's the only hour I tell anybody the truth.

I have never once asked anyone to stay.

I'm about to ask the one woman who came here to make me leave.

This is the first book in The Black Aces Series. Reading order:

Cold Crush.

Cold Kiss.

Cold Blooded.

Cold Comfort.

Cold Temptation.

Cold Fire.
